derived_exact_structures.name: F2_SYMPLECTIC_RANK_ONE_NORMAL_FORM
derived_exact_structures.hypotheses: (V,B) nondegenerate symplectic over F2; T symplectic; T!=I; rank(T-I)=1
derived_exact_structures.conclusion: unique v!=0 with im(T-I)=<v> and T(x)=x+B(x,v)v
derived_exact_structures.corollary: im(T-I)<=W iff v in W minus {0}; candidate transvections parameterized by at most 2^dim(W)-1 directions
derived_exact_structures.credit_boundary: does not identify an absolute source W-line or prove the geometric action without source lock
